changed_since_initial_full_read.title: Bug: GraphQL error-only pages become data rows in TypeScript arrays and JSON
changed_since_initial_full_read.body:
<!-- deepviz-r22-graphql-error-carrier -->
## Reproduced defect: failed GraphQL page becomes a data row

The TypeScript public normalizer silently succeeds when a supplied GraphQL
page array or its encoded JSON contains an error-only response after valid data.
Instead of rejecting the failed page, it flattens the transport error into an
invented record, increments the count, and emits **no warning**.

One cause, not six tickets: `data:null`, absent `data`, and `data:{}` each fail
through automatic array and encoded-JSON carriers. Direct-envelope, real async
stream, explicit-path, and Python controls already reject these same envelopes.
This does **not** report the separate known unexpected-connection-sibling loss.

Related parent: #7 (nested/GraphQL pages); related contract: #14.
Fresh complete open-issue/body/comment review found no specific duplicate.
Those broad feature stories are not the same bounded defect report.

## Exact source and already-executed independent QA

- Product checkpoint: **5340bc69b7203ad7a9166543062482d819f9b705**;
  [TypeScript source](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/5340bc69b7203ad7a9166543062482d819f9b705/packages/deepviz/src/normalize.ts#L95-L118).
- Permanent independent probes/evidence: **648f399e2745aa1f62319cddb15fb0095ab0a34c**;
  [strict Node suite](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/648f399e2745aa1f62319cddb15fb0095ab0a34c/tests/r15_probes/role03/graphql-pages.test.mjs),
  [Python controls](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/648f399e2745aa1f62319cddb15fb0095ab0a34c/tests/r15_probes/role03/test_graphql_pages.py),
  [actual diagnostic](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/648f399e2745aa1f62319cddb15fb0095ab0a34c/docs/coordination/evidence/R15-03/node-carrier-diagnostic.json#L190-L229),
  [commands/results/import hashes](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/648f399e2745aa1f62319cddb15fb0095ab0a34c/docs/coordination/evidence/R15-03/verification.json).
- Loaded source SHA256:
  `d1b45d2a55dfd05361184a57da952a0da735e9b6d72c2491f908ef27bda22371`;
  compiled `normalize.js` SHA256:
  `adb0493123fd478567212e76e2c6e52c828aeaa9eb5425c219b5b1a576689612`.
- Windows / Nodev26.13.1 / Python3.12.16. Independent isolated source was byte-equal
  to checkpoint5340, not a sibling dirty build. No mocks, xfails, sampling or skips.

Already-executed strict command (not newly rerun during bug filing):

```powershell
node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/r15_probes/role03/graphql-pages.test.mjs
```

Actual: **73tests /63PASS /10FAIL /0skip /0cancel**, exit1,469.4565ms from an
external-CWD portability run. **Six** failures are this error-carrier cause;
the other **four** are explicitly deduplicated known F1 sibling-loss tests and
must not inflate this bug. Same-source Python controls: **73PASS /0skip**,
exit0,0.81s. [Exact failed IDs and raw logs](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/tree/648f399e2745aa1f62319cddb15fb0095ab0a34c/docs/coordination/evidence/R15-03).

## Minimal two-page literal (no fixture builder)

From the repository root after building that pinned package:

```js
import {normalize} from './packages/deepviz/dist/index.js';
const pages = [
  {data: {feed: {nodes: [{id: 'kept', measure: 2}]}}},
  {data: null, errors: [{message: 'late page unavailable'}]}
];
normalize(pages, {kind: 'table', aggregation: 'none', max_points: 100});
// Also reproduces with JSON.stringify(pages) and format: 'json'.
```

Actual saved output for the literal array:

```json
{
  "records": [
    {"id": "kept", "measure": 2},
    {"data": null, "errors.0.message": "late page unavailable"}
  ],
  "input_count": 2,
  "warnings": [],
  "strategy": "none"
}
```

Larger strict fixtures keep40valid records, an empty intermediate page and then
the failed page: actual41records/41input_count/no warnings. The empty page is
not the termination point; the error envelope is wrongly treated as an observation.

## Expected behavior / fix acceptance

- Reject error-only GraphQL pages concisely and consistently across supplied
  arrays, encoded JSON, direct envelopes, async streams and explicit paths;
  never return a successful prefix or invented error row. Existing direct/stream
  controls use `GraphQL response contains errors and no data`.
- Make all **six** permanent error-carrier negatives pass without xfail/skipping
  or weakening count/value/type/order/early-stop assertions. Keep known F1 sibling
  regressions separate, strict, and independently tracked.
- Preserve ordinary business records containing an `errors` field: the existing
  sync+async positive produces `{'id':'business-record','errors.0.message':...}`.
  Do not reject all fields named `errors` indiscriminately.
- Preserve partial-error warnings with usable data, null-node warning disclosure,
  empty-page continuation, valid explicit selection, and exact ordered repeated
  values/counts (five records include four legitimate equal repeated nodes).
- Source-flow diagnosis: `sequenceEnvelope` requires a data collection;
  `unpack`'s array ordinary-row branch therefore bypasses `checkGraphql` for these
  failed envelopes. Reuse the existing validation semantics without inventing
  implicit connection merging or an object-only node policy.

Source ownership remains16/R04; QA has not changed implementation or existing
oracles. Proposed priorityP1 because failed input silently becomes fabricated
data, subject to maintainer triage. Leave open until a reviewed fix and fresh
independent candidate retest; this report is not a fix, greenCI, merge, closure
or final-release signoff. No test/build/browser rerun was needed to file the bug.

changed_since_initial_full_read.title: Bug: synchronous browser initialization loses readiness Promise and error channel
changed_since_initial_full_read.body:
<!-- deepviz-r22-ready-promise -->
## Reproduced P2: synchronous initialization drops readiness and failure reporting

Exact product source: **7bcfb2dcbf99f9deb44a2b5558373bd3aaccd0e6**, [engines.py:787-789](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/7bcfb2dcbf99f9deb44a2b5558373bd3aaccd0e6/python/deepviz/src/deepviz/engines.py#L787-L789). Its `payloads.map(...)` initializes renderers before assignment of `window.deepvizReady` and attachment of the intended catch. A missing ECharts/G2 library throws synchronously, bypassing both. Readiness remains **undefined**, `body.dataset.renderError` remains absent, and a naive **await readiness falsely fulfills** despite a blank chart. A host requiring a Promise reaches its own observation deadline instead.

One shared bootstrap cause, not two engine tickets. Existing warnings disclose CDN dependency; successful artifact creation is not itself a browser-readiness claim. Broad related scopes #12/#13/#16/#23 (and trust parent #21) do not already report this specific bug. Complete fresh open-item enumeration/relevant bodies and comments found no duplicate or marker. The known **loaded-G2 all-negative heatmap ASYNC rejection** has an actual readiness Promise and is a different cause.

## Existing independent reproduction and controls -- no rerun for filing

Original immutable QA/probe/evidence: **41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5**. [Full report](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/reports/R21-14-offline-host-failure.md), [actual DOM/readiness/network observations](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/evidence/R21-14/host-observations.json), [strict RED log](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/evidence/R21-14/pytest-live.log), [source/import/tool hashes](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/evidence/R21-14/tool-artifacts.json).

Use real `create_tools(NEW_OUTPUT)` StructuredTool.invoke for render_echarts/render_antv with rows [{label:'A & B',value:3},{label:'C < D',value:9}] and spec {kind:'bar',x:'label',y:'value',aggregation:'none',title:'Offline <literal> & host',width:700,height:340}. The actual generator materialized/hash-checked exact7bc source:11files/seven imported modules. Three actual tool calls include the Matplotlib static positive; this is not an end-to-end DeepAgent LLM/provider run.

Load each returned **unchanged** HTML and deliberately abort its external runtime URL:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/echarts@6.1.0/dist/echarts.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@antv/g2@5.4.8/dist/g2.min.js

[Probe/README with exact commands](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/tree/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/tests/r21_probes/role14): generate_tools.py, offline_host.mjs, then pytest test_live_host.py with explicit --host-evidence. For a future fixed-head retest QA must explicitly adapt the generator's fixed7bc pin/provenance to the proposed fix while preserving original strict expectations, not accidentally retest7bc or borrow moving HEAD.

Observed per denied case: one expected fixture `net::ERR_FAILED`; separate uncaught `ReferenceError: echarts is not defined` / `ReferenceError: G2 is not defined`; readiness/then undefined, await falsely fulfilled, declared renderError absent, zero chart children/graphics/text. The **1500ms budget belongs only to the observer**, NOT a product timeout. No product spinner/aria-busy or indefinite real-host spinner was demonstrated. This controlled request denial is NOT a live-CDN-health or exploit claim. HTML/bootstrap/nativepayload were not edited; no fake renderer or downloaded-code execution.

Recorded strict result: **exit1,2failed/8passed/0skipped**, no xfail; four separate oracle controls passed. Five real browser cases: two controlled denials and three real positives; seven actual images opened. Windows/Python3.12.16/LangChain-core1.8.5/Playwright1.65.1/Chromium159.0.8154.6. No generation/test/browser/build/advisory replay to file this bug.

## Useful fallback and real positives are preserved

Both denied cases retain exact literal A & B=3 / C < D=9, headers/caption/counts2-to-2/none and inert nativeJSON. Focus the genuine data summary and press Enter: the real table is accessible through the accessibility tree. No data-loss claim. [Blank chart](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/evidence/R21-14/echarts-denied.png), [keyboard-opened fallback](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/evidence/R21-14/echarts-denied-fallback-open.png).

[Matplotlib static positive](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/41477a7d1b2d332dbb3790d31987d3861e4137b5/docs/coordination/evidence/R21-14/matplotlib-static-offline.png): zero external requests/runtime scripts/console-pageerrors, real siblingSVG and originalPNG opened with literal3/9bars. Static HTML intentionally needs no interactive readiness Promise.

ECharts/G2 local positives use **real preexisting exact bytes**, explicitly NOT CDN health: ECharts6.1.0 SHA256 b66b25aeb4df84e33199dc21694014d336d222cbd9deb0e5a7c14bd6aa0d0fd0; G2 5.4.8 SHA256 7e7d346cab68c002a889dc6145bfc1f9ae1391be82ce8d514fb106ef3a6e6412. Both actual Promises fulfill; actual graphics/literal3/9values inspected; zero console/pageerrors/failedresources/unexpectedrequests.

## Minimal proposal and acceptance -- owner R04, not an applied fix

- [ ] Assign/create the readiness Promise BEFORE executing callbacks, so synchronous throws and asynchronous rejections both reach the declared catch/error channel. No fake fulfillment/engine.
- [ ] Truthful actionable accessible DOM failure status distinguishes failed interactive rendering from useful data fallback. Preserve literal rows/counts/warnings/keyboard access.
- [ ] At exact proposed fixed head, both strict denial assertions pass with rejected readiness and declared error signal. Separate expected deliberate ERR_FAILED resource events; no unexpected/unhandled initialization errors or silent success.
- [ ] Preserve all three real positives and literal3/9values with no unexpected errors; static output need not have a Promise.
- [ ] Genuine non-author fixed-head review/retest and source-specific CI/default-merge evidence before closure. Original2RED remain failures; no universal-offline/all-engine/all-kind/LLM/security/full900-goal approval.

R04 owns code/policy/integration/closure; the separate _antv-only producer release does not grant the shared HTML wrapper. One cause/one bug; leave open until acceptance is evidenced. No auto-close, second-engine ticket or900-count padding.

changed_since_initial_full_read.title: Bug: Plotly data labels, legend and hover become active links instead of literal text
changed_since_initial_full_read.body: ## Reproduced bug: data text is interpreted as Plotly HTML Plain data labels must remain literal text. In actual Chromium output, Plotly categorical labels, an isolated legend name, and native hover text turn an inert HTTPS-anchor string into an active SVG link. Native title double quotes are also displayed as `"` rather than the original text. **Scope/severity:** confirmed HTML/link interpretation and literal-text/data-integrity defect; proposed P2 hardening. **No JavaScript execution, clicked navigation, credential access, or remote exploitation was demonstrated.** No payload link was clicked; all unexpected network requests were blocked. The native-title observation is an inert text-correctness mismatch, not title XSS. Coordination fix owner: **R04, Python `engines.py::_plotly`** (not the separately released AntV `_antv` function). Related broad stories: #10, #21, #23. Related independent role02 category/series anchor observation is the **same bug**, not another ticket. Complete live open-issue deduplication found no specific existing report of this failure; the three related stories describe general feature/security/visual acceptance. ## Immutable source, probes and actual results - Tested Python source: **`3aa521a5d41e8f5cfcb21a5efc008bb3ff2cfcab`**. Four loaded production-module Git blobs matched the pinned commit. This is baseline evidence, **not a claim that the moving/final candidate was retested or fixed**. - Original strict probe/evidence commit: **`c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d`** — [R10 test](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d/tests/r10_probes/role20/test_plotly_literal_labels.py), [native DOM/values](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d/docs/coordination/evidence/R10-20/strict-red.json), [source-identity hashes](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d/docs/coordination/evidence/R10-20/identity.json), [exact executed command ledger](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d/docs/coordination/evidence/R10-20/commands.md). Actual `pytest` exit **1: 2 failed / 4 passed / 0 skipped, 20.29 s**. The two categorical chart/dashboard cases fail strict anchor absence; numeric/time chart/dashboard controls pass. - Novel isolated-sink probe/evidence commit: **`f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399`** — [R13 test](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399/tests/r13_probes/role20/test_plotly_sink_discrimination.py), [native DOM/values/source hashes](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399/docs/coordination/evidence/R13-20/strict-red.json), [exact executed command ledger](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399/docs/coordination/evidence/R13-20/commands.md). Actual `pytest` exit **1: 3 failed / 0 passed / 0 skipped, 9.63 s**. No xfail, relaxed assertions, source fix or old-six-case replay. - All nine recorded cases awaited the real native render. Browser helpers themselves exited 0; **zero console/page errors and zero unexpected network requests**. Existing Python 3.12.16 / Plotly 6.9.0, Chromium 159.0.8154.6 / Playwright 1.65.1 / Node 26.13.1; self-contained Plotly HTML. No dependency install or paid model call. - Reporter/session: independent QA `ses_de567801cffeGZFlt50oYv0Dnt`. This issue records already executed evidence; **no browser/build/SUM/scale rerun was performed to file it**. The later R16 finite-SUM pass does not fix this text bug. ## Literal expected versus actual DOM The original public-render fixture uses `aggregation='none'`, three rows with y `[3, 7, 11]`, and these categorical x values: ```text R10 safe link R10 literal label ``` The series field is `R10 literal series`. The `.invalid` address is an inert test sentinel, not an exploitation target. **Expected:** display each complete original string literally, including `...` / `...`, without creating a navigation link or event-handler attribute. Preserve the original manifest records and accessible-table cells, numeric values and coordinates. **Actual:** one native anchor in the chart and one per child (two) in the dashboard: ```html R10 safe link ``` Native text drops the anchor/bold syntax, while manifest records and table cells retain the original strings. Three marks per child and y `[3, 7, 11]` are preserved; no event-handler attribute was created by the empty-handler string. The isolated R13 observations distinguish the other display sinks: | Sink | Literal input / expected | Actual native output | |---|---|---| | Legend only, numeric x `[1,2,4]` | `R13 legend` displayed literally | One SVG HTTPS anchor; native legend text only `R13 legend` | | Geo native hover, x `[-120,-60,120]`, y `[10,20,35]` | `R13 hover` displayed literally | Before pointer: zero anchors. First actual pointer hover: one SVG HTTPS anchor; tooltip text `(−120, 10)R13 hover`. No click. | | Native title, ISO-date x | `R13 "title" & 'quote'` displayed literally | Native text is `R13 "title" & 'quote'`; zero anchors/handlers. | The second geo hover similarly strips `` markup; the third empty-handler image string remains literal. Numeric/ISO-date values, three marks, expected relative pixel spacing (1:2; geo 1:3), and original records remain unchanged. No geometry loss or execution is claimed. ## Actual inspected image evidence These are the generated PNGs that QA actually opened, not mockups. JSON linked above contains exact artifact/PNG hashes and native DOM: ![Categorical chart: interpreted blue link label](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d/docs/coordination/evidence/R10-20/categorical-chart.png) ![Two-child dashboard: same literal-text failure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/c1bf91c5439d585e2ff157752f380cfa4fe85c6d/docs/coordination/evidence/R10-20/categorical-dashboard.png) ![Isolated legend anchor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399/docs/coordination/evidence/R13-20/legend.png) ![Actual native pointer hover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399/docs/coordination/evidence/R13-20/hover.png) ![Inert title with visibly corrupted quote entities](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399/docs/coordination/evidence/R13-20/title.png) ## Reproduce / independent fixed-source retest Use existing render extras and Node/Playwright/Chromium. Keep a clean source checkout at the SHA under test and a separate checkout of probe commit `f9087d0518e74378e810b9efe6d6630a12044399` (which includes unchanged R10 tests). Verify actual loaded module paths/Git blobs against the source SHA. **Always use new unique basetemp/XML paths; do not overwrite the recorded baseline.** Exact original executed commands are in the two immutable command-ledger links above. Portable PowerShell recipe (substitute actual existing paths; not a new run claimed by this issue): ```powershell $source = '' $probes = '' $python = '\Scripts\python.exe' $env:PYTHONPATH = "$source\python\deepviz\src" $env:R10_20_NODE_MODULES = '' $env:R13_20_NODE_MODULES = $env:R10_20_NODE_MODULES & $python -m pytest "$probes\tests\r10_probes\role20\test_plotly_literal_labels.py" "$probes\tests\r13_probes\role20\test_plotly_sink_discrimination.py" -q --basetemp='' --junitxml='' ``` The recorded separate baseline runs total five strict failing cases and four passing controls; do not relabel collector exit 0 as test GREEN. A future fixed-source run must be genuine and independently recorded, not inferred from these results. ## Source-owner direction and acceptance At the pinned source, [`_plotly` lines 352–411](https://github.com/sandeshbagmare/deepviz-agent-toolkit/blob/3aa521a5d41e8f5cfcb21a5efc008bb3ff2cfcab/python/deepviz/src/deepviz/engines.py#L352-L411) passes raw category/trace-name/geo-hover strings into Plotly rich-text sinks, while the native title uses quote-escaping intended for HTML. This is one Plotly literal-display boundary defect, not five invented issues. Proposal only: apply Plotly-specific literal display-string handling without weakening outer HTML/table/script serialization or changing numeric/time semantics. No production fix has been made by this QA lane. - [ ] Literal full text is retained for categorical labels, legend/series, hover and native title (quotes/ampersands included); no unexpected bold/HTML interpretation. - [ ] **Zero data-created SVG/HTML anchors and zero event-handler attributes** in standalone charts and both dashboard children, including after real native pointer hover. - [ ] Original records/table cells/counts/warnings, y values, numeric/ISO-date/geo coordinate types and relative spacing are preserved. Keep existing HTML/script/table escaping intact. - [ ] Run the unchanged nine strict cases against a clean frozen fixed source with new outputs: 9 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped, zero console/page errors/unexpected requests. Inspect real new PNG/DOM evidence; do not click payload links. - [ ] Manager obtains the required independent review/test evidence and applicable focused gates before merge/closure. Keep this bug open until that evidence exists; this report is not final signoff, green CI, a closure request, or a 900-issue completion claim.
